title: KPI ticker
description: Use to land one headline number: a big figure that counts up with a label and an optional change chip. The figure size fits the frame width (9:16 safe); override with fontSize.
props: {value: number; label: string; from?: number /*0*/; prefix?: string; suffix?: string; valueFormat?: string /*',.0f'*/; delta?: string; deltaColor?: string /*'#34d399'*/; color?: string; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*40*/; fontSize?: number /*fits width*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Space Grotesk, sans-serif'*/}
example:
import {KpiTicker} from './blocks/kpi-ticker/KpiTicker.tsx';
<KpiTicker value={128400} prefix="$" label="Monthly revenue" delta="+12.4%" />
